source_title: Civilization #49: The Dutch Golden Age and the Rise of the Middle Class
summary: This Dutch Golden Age lecture is already-public support for Attention Capture's middle-class status-proof anchor and the reviewed Middle-Class Anxiety seed: Dutch Calvinism turns salvation anxiety, trade uncertainty, competition, household discipline, art, and material accumulation into the respectable class's proof machinery, while VOC corporate sovereignty and Dutch painting create held comparison pressure for Power, Strategy, Secret Society, and media/art boundaries.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Dutch middle-class life is driven by anxiety, uncertainty, and competition, which turn money-making, materialism, art objects, and household accumulation into proof that status has not collapsed.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Attention Capture page already carries this stable anchor, and the episode read already links the exact money-as-faith paragraph to it. No read JSON repair is needed.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the Dutch middle-class status-proof layer. The page already uses the 2025-05-06 lecture to show that anxiety, uncertainty, competition, wealth, household order, art, and materialism make middle-class attention keep moving through work, accumulation, display, and self-policing.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Attention owns the focus and anxiety discipline. The held middle-class seed owns the fuller status-proof ecology only as routing discipline; Power owns money as proof/reality, Education owns child or school formation, and Mass Society owns scale and conformity.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already reviewed as a held proposal seed: this lecture remains the cleanest source for the full status-proof ecology, including salvation anxiety, trade uncertainty, competition among the wealthy, cultural containment, poor-person talismans, Vermeer, and respectable domestic hypocrisy.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Do not promote Middle-Class Anxiety directly from this source. The reviewed seed says promotion needs either repeated public-page duplication or a wider cluster where status proof, cultural containment, and political conformity all appear together.

concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns conversion into lived reality, not Dutch history as a topic. Strategy owns war finance and maritime adaptation; Secret Society owns mobile-capital trust only when hidden coordination is active; Attention owns anxiety discipline.

new_lens_seeds.title: Middle-Class Anxiety As Status Discipline
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A class without secure inherited rank must keep proving its worth through wealth, work, household order, taste, art, cleanliness, education, and fear of falling; culture absorbs the pressure by making forbidden desire and failed respectability visible at a safe distance.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The reviewed seed already compares Protestant anxiety, the Dutch Golden Age, Tocqueville's America, Marx/capitalism correction, and later capital extraction. This source is the clearest Dutch formulation and should remain the routing rule for full status-proof ecology.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a reviewed proposal seed. Attention Capture already carries the compact public anchor, and the cross-page review says promotion needs broader duplication or a tighter cluster.

new_lens_seeds.title: Corporation As Sovereign War Finance
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A company becomes a political technology when equity turns military conflict into investment upside and private corporate form receives public powers: law, armies, currency, monopoly, and colonial violence.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This could compare VOC, East India Company, Bank of England credit, platform-state fronts, and later public-private control surfaces, but one Dutch source should not create a public page.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as comparison pressure until VOC, East India Company, Bank of England, and modern platform-state sources are reviewed together. Route current evidence by active mechanism instead.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-05-06, this source sits between the 2025-03-27 Protestant anxiety lecture and the 2025-05-15 Tocqueville/America lecture: Protestant anxiety supplies religious proof pressure, the Dutch source gives household/art/status ecology, and Tocqueville democratizes the pressure into American status competition and conformity.

Jiang dates the VOC to 1602 and treats it as the institution that lets a small anti-Spanish republic convert sea power, East Indies trade, equity, and quasi-state powers into global wealth and colonial violence.

The lecture closes by making Dutch corporations, capitalism, middle-class life, artwork, and literature the seedbed for the next class on England, so future British-empire impacts should treat the Dutch layer as a predecessor rather than a standalone endpoint.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is needed: Attention Capture already carries the stable middle-class status-proof anchor with this source, and the episode read already links the relevant paragraph to `lens-point:middle-class-status-proof-keeps-attention-moving`.
